description:
Submit a BYO python_model to a leaderboard track for server-side scoring.

Nimbus scores it server-side under the track's fixed protocol — you
submit code, never results. Poll ``leaderboard.status`` with the
returned ``submissionId``; scoring takes minutes (classical) to tens
of minutes (deep). Requirements must be plain PyPI names/specs (max
20, no URLs). Identical code resubmission is idempotent per track
(``deduplicated: true``).

backbone_kind.description:
Checkpoint family for the BYO backbone lane — one
of the zoo's supported kinds (e.g. "cbramod", "labram").

backbone_license.description: License declared for the backbone checkpoint.

backbone_repo.description: HF 'org/name' repo id for the BYO backbone lane.

backbone_revision.description: Full 40-char commit SHA pinning the backbone.

class_name.description: Contract class to instantiate; omit to auto-detect.

code.description:
Python source defining a class with fit(X, y, info) and
predict(X) (<=256KB; validate first with python.validate).
Omit when declaring a backbone instead.

dataset_id.description:
Open dataset id (see catalog.leaderboard crossSubject
datasets, e.g. "BNCI2014_001").

name.description: Display name on the board (<=100 chars).

track.description:
"cross_subject" (default — full-data leave-one-subject-out,
seed 42) or "pretrained_few_trial" (efficiency track: LOSO with
a protocol-fixed 100-trials-per-subject cap; code that imports
torch must declare its trained parameter count as a class
attribute — PARAMS_TRAINED = <int> — which becomes the row's
paramsTrained and is cross-checked when computable).

name: leaderboard.submit
title: Leaderboard.Submit
